figures.caption: Figure 1: The proposed pipeline based on learning under privileged information, which distills information from a multimodal (audio-text) teacher model into a unimodal (audio only) student model. The teacher model comprises frozen ASR and NMT models to generate text transcripts and translations, respectively. Trainable models process the generated texts to extract latent representations that are further integrated via cross-modal transformer blocks. Best viewed in color.
Table 2: Performance of unimodal, multimodal and KD-based models on the MSP-Podcast corpus [7], alongside inference time in ms (measured on one Nvidia RTX 4060 8GB GPU, using a batch size of 8).
Table 1: Summary of training and architectural hyperparameters across model configurations.

Figure 2: Accuracy rates of the WavLM student across different values for the distillation weight λ. The teacher is the CCMT based on Audio + En + Fr. The dashed line marks the WavLM baseline trained without KD (λ = 0). The best result is obtained at λ = 0.7.
